scope: Whether the pairs whose boxes nest are one part inside another, settled by ray

method.test: odd crossings of the obstacle's surface means inside
method.intersection: Moller-Trumbore against every triangle at once
method.directions_fixed: the same every run, so the answer does not move; disagreement is reported
method.points: the centroid of the mirrored part, and one of its vertices
method.mirror: the build's own M(y0), checked against the box the contact report recorded

what_this_does_not_give: whether the parts that are not inside each other are far enough apart
contact between surfaces, which the triangle stage already reports
anything about pairs whose boxes do not nest
any judgement of whether the layout is sound
